title: Global Heat Forum gathers 600 leaders to scale investment for extreme heat action
summary: Press release, 6 October 2026: the first Global Heat Forum, Bangkok, 6 to 9 October, with the first country-level heat and health assessments for Bangladesh, Bhutan, India and Nepal and a roadmap for investment and action on extreme heat.

title: Philanthropy Asia Alliance supports Southeast Asia Heat Health Hub to scale coordinated action on extreme heat
summary: Press release, 8 October 2026: support for the next stage of the Global Heat Health Information Network’s Southeast Asia Hub, including funding for work in Indonesia and Thailand in 2027 and a second Southeast Asia Heat Health Forum.

title: Bangladesh, 3 other South Asian countries launch new initiative to tackle extreme heat
summary: News report, 8 October 2026, on the first heat and health assessment for Bangladesh, released at the Global Heat Forum: it notes the country’s first urban heatwave action plan, for Narayanganj, national guidelines on heat-related illness and a public campaign, “Beat the Heat”.

title: New initiatives launched to address extreme heat in South Asia
summary: WMO news item, 20 February 2026: The Rockefeller Foundation and Wellcome fund a South Asia Climate–Health Desk under the WHO–WMO Climate and Health Joint Programme, and a South Asia Scientific Research Consortium through a Rockefeller grant to IISER Pune.
